  <h1>Büchi's S1S decidability theorem (1960)</h1>
  <p>An omega-language is omega-regular iff it is definable in monadic second-order logic S1S. Accepting runs translate to second-order existential quantifiers, while logical connectives translate to automata operations, proving S1S decidability.</p>
</noscript>
